thread:
maria: Deploybot pushed v2.14.0 to prod (canary -> gradual -> 100%). Quick check: synthetic heartbeat probe in eu-west shows p95 up ~120ms vs baseline. KV probe OK. Anyone watching postdeploy telemetry?

deploy-bot: deployment v2.14.0 -> prod completed at 2025-11-03T15:01:09Z :white_check_mark: (rollout_id=rl-9c3)

liam: saw the alert, looking at prefills. p50 looks fine, tail moved. Could be warmup jitter after variant switch.

aj: can you paste the quickcheck? I ran a couple, here's the command I used:
```
./ops/smoketest --probe heartbeat --region eu-west --window 10m --raw
```
Output: p95=118ms, p99=210ms, error_rate=0.1% (timeouts)

maria: thanks. low error rate so not full rollback territory. thinking: pin routing to previous model variant for eu-west for 20m while we gather traces + run expanded synthetic profile. Opinions? :eyes:

elena: agree with pin. prefer a targeted pin (route model_variant=v2.13.9 for eu-west) rather than full service rollback. That buys time to replay longer traces. I'll update release notes and notify CS if we extend pin.

aj: will run the deeper runbook and attach traces. If p95 stays >100ms after 20m we consider rollback. I'll also trigger an occupancy check on hosts.

liam: quick metric: KV cache hit ratio steady at 98.7% so not cache thrash. Something timing-related on the new tokenization microchange maybe. I can run a compare of tokenizer latencies between variants.

maria: plan: 1) aj pins eu-west route to model_variant=v2.13.9 for 20m 2) liam runs tokenizer compare and posts traces 3) aj runs expanded synthetic (longer tails) 4) elena updates release notes & CS. If metrics look stable, unpin and let 2.14 continue. If p95>100ms persist or errors >0.5%, rollback.

aj: pinning now. command: `redwood route pin --region eu-west --variant v2.13.9 --duration 20m --reason "postdeploy heartbeat drift"`

sre-bot: route pin applied (eu-west -> v2.13.9) by aj at 2025-11-03T15:06:22Z. TTL 20m.

liam: starting tokenizer A/B traces now, sending links when ready.

aj: kicked off expanded synth: `./ops/smoketest --probe heartbeat --tail 1000 --region eu-west --duration 10m`

maria: thanks team. tagging this thread for post-pin check at +18m to decide unpin vs rollback. :thumbsup:

elena: release notes patched with a "postdeploy: observed heartbeat tail increase in eu-west; pinned variant for investigation" entry and CS notified.

liam: posted traces: https://internal/redwood/trace/xyz (short) - tokenizer p95 delta ~20ms on one host, others negligible.

aj: expanded synth shows p95 dropping to ~85ms after pin, errors stable. Will let pin run finish and report at 15:24Z.

maria: ok—if aj confirms p95<100ms and traces look good we unpin and close. If not, prepare rollback playbook.

sre-bot: pin TTL expiring in 2m.

aj: pin expired, unpinning now: `redwood route unpin --region eu-west --variant v2.13.9`

sre-bot: route pin removed by aj at 2025-11-03T15:24:09Z.

maria: post-unpin quickcheck: p95=92ms, p99=140ms, errors 0.05%. Looks stable. Leaving monitoring watch for 1h, but no rollback. Closing thread unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
